Robert Peston | Robert James Kenneth Peston (born 25 April 1960) is a British journalist and presenter. Bob Brolly | Robert Joseph Brolly MBE (known professionally as Bob Brolly) is a Northern Ireland-born broadcaster, singer and entertainer, who presents shows for BBC Local Radio in the United Kingdom. Sophy Ridge | Sophy Arabella Ridge (born 17 October 1984) is an English broadcast journalist.  Ridge was born and raised in Richmond upon Thames, London.  Her early education was at the Tiffin Girls' School.  After graduation from St Edmund Hall, Oxford with a degree in English Literature, she worked as a journalist at the tabloid newspaper "News of the World".  Ridge then worked as a political correspondent for Sky News where as of 2017 she presents "Sophy Ridge on Sunday".
